monster_description.1: Female version of the Rathalos wyvern. Unlike its male counterpart, it usually patrols its territory from the ground. Its tail spikes are filled with poison.
monster_description.2: A legendary black dragon said to have prowled these lands from the days of old. Many skilled hunters have sought to challenge it, but none ever return. A monster shrouded in mystery...
monster_description.3: Herbivorous, deer-like monsters. Valued for their horns, they tend to run away at the first hint of danger. They are also hunted for their meat, which is chewy but flavorful.
monster_description.4: Wild pigs covered in moss and fungus. Sometimes you will even find mushrooms growing on them. Their meat is known as a delicacy. Though normally docile, they will charge you if angered!
monster_description.5: A large wild boar. Foul tempered, they will charge hunters on sight. They are aggressive and powerful, so beware! They are often hunted for their meat, which many hunters find delicious.
monster_description.6: A bird-like wyvern with a huge beak and large ears that splay open when it is angered. With its sensitive hearing it dislikes loud noises. It is smaller but faster than other wyverns.
monster_description.7: A giant dragon few have seen and lived to tell the tale. When on the rampage it wreaks havoc on all in its path. The guild has built a fortress to repel the beast, but will it hold?
monster_description.8: The alpha monster form of the Cephalos. Larger and armored with black scales, they fit the appearance of a leader perfectly. Their fins hold a paralyzing toxin.
monster_description.9: Cat-like humanoids called Lynians that are noted for their white fur. Felynes are quiet and peaceful until angered, in which case they may attack. Capable of speech, they are sometimes found in the employ of human masters.
monster_description.11: Male wyvern that keeps a nest and patrols its patch of territory from the air in search of prey. Its claws are filled with a poison that weakens its quarry.
monster_description.12: Hunted as a food source, these creatures are preyed upon by both hunter and monster alike. Usually timid, in packs they will defend themselves with surprising strength.
monster_description.13: An orange and green-striped species of small carnivores found mainly in desert zones. Traveling in packs, their large fangs and claws contain a neurotoxin that is used to paralyze prey.
monster_description.14: Two-horned wyverns found in desert zones. They are capable of burrowing into sand to attack prey from below. Incredibly violent and proud, they are known to unleash terrible wrath when accosted.
monster_description.15: Loathsome wyverns that live inside caves. Near blind, they detect their prey by smell. They are capable of generating electric shocks, which they use to paralyze their prey.
monster_description.16: Aggressive, carnivorous monsters that often travel in packs. Even a master hunter should take care not to become surrounded! Wide ranging, they are found in many different areas, such as the Jungle or Forest and Hills.
monster_description.17: A large wyvern found in volcanic zones. They possess a fiery breath attack and the ability to emit a sleeping gas. They also have extremely hard scales that deflect most weapon attacks.
monster_description.19: An enormous, wasp-like insectoid with a poisonous stinger that paralyzes prey. Easily damaged, there are rarely any usable parts left to harvest from them once they are killed.
monster_description.20: A wyvern that can generate disorienting flashes of light when its prominent head crest is struck. Its rubbery hide resists damage and can ward off shock traps, while its spit carries a deadly venom. However, they are quite timid.
monster_description.21: An enormous, flightless, aquatic wyvern with wings that have evolved into fins for swimming. Although superficially fish-like, they can move on land as well. They love frogs.
monster_description.22: A large wyvern found in volcanic zones. They are the juvenile form of the Gravios. They have a steel-like carapace that requires powerful items to crack. Emits poison gas.
monster_description.23: Cat-like humanoids called Lynians with black fur. Their sticky-fingers never miss a chance to steal things and take them back to their den, forcing victims to seek out their lost items. Distracted by the sight of Felvine.
monster_description.24: A Vespoid-like monster with a thick shell. Easily damaged, there are rarely any usable materials left to harvest from them once killed. But if you could sap their health gradually...
monster_description.25: Hunted for their meat, which is buried under a thick, armored hide. Aggressive compared to the Aptonoth, hunting them can be a challenge. Apceros eggs are a valuable guild commodity.
monster_description.26: A large-horned wyvern found in desert zones. Their giant horn makes their attacks very dangerous. While they have no breath attack, their ear-splitting roar is the bane of hunters.
monster_description.27: The alpha monster that leads a Velociprey pack. They are larger and have a more prominent crest. Highly territorial, but will retreat to a safe place when injured to recover.
monster_description.28: The alpha monster that leads a Genprey pack. They are larger and have more prominent crest. Found in the desert, they can paralyze prey using their fangs and claws.
monster_description.30: A vivid red species of small carnivores often found in subtropical zones. Sacs in their throat contain a powerful poison that slowly drains the health of their prey.
monster_description.31: The alpha monster that leads an Ioprey pack. They are larger and have a more prominent crest. Found in subtropical zones, they spit a poison that can sap the life force of prey.
monster_description.33: The Kirin is said to glow a faint blue, but so few have seen it that details are scarce. It is apparently capable of calling forth lightning at will. Kirin material is very valuable.
monster_description.34: Wyverns found only in the Desert. They resemble a Plesioth, but live and "swim" in sand rather than water. They seldom appear above land, but when their hearing is disturbed...
monster_description.35: A species of small bird-like carnivores known to inhabit the snowy mountains. Their white skin is beautiful, but their temperament is not. They are known to spit ice at hunters, and attack in deadly packs.
monster_description.37: A subspecies of Rathian with vibrant pink scales. Pink Rathian wield their toxic tails more skillfully than normal Rathian, using a wide variety of attacks to weaken their prey before eventually moving in for the kill.
monster_description.38: A bird-like wyvern with a huge beak and large ears that splay open when it is angered. With its sensitive hearing it dislikes loud noises. It is smaller but faster than other wyverns.
monster_description.39: A wyvern that can generate disorienting flashes of light when its prominent head crest is struck. Its rubbery hide resists damage and can ward off shock traps, while its spit carries a deadly venom. However, they are quite timid.
monster_description.41: A rare variant of Rathalos with a beautiful silver body reminiscent of the sun. Little is known about their behavior or physiology--including the source of their rich silver sheen.
monster_description.42: A rare variant of Rathian with a beautiful golden body reminiscent of the moon. Little is known about their behavior or physiology--including the source of their rich golden sheen.
monster_description.44: A large-horned wyvern found in desert zones. Their giant horn makes their attacks very dangerous. While they have no breath attack, their ear-splitting roar is the bane of hunters.
monster_description.45: Loathsome wyverns that live inside caves. Near blind, they detect their prey by smell. They are capable of generating electric shocks, which they use to paralyze their prey.
monster_description.46: An enormous, flightless, aquatic wyvern with wings that have evolved into fins for swimming. Although superficially fish-like, they can move on land as well. They love frogs.
monster_description.47: A large wyvern found in volcanic zones. They possess a fiery breath attack and the ability to emit a sleeping gas. They also have extremely hard scales that deflect most weapon attacks.
monster_description.48: A large carapaceon with a giant monster's skull on its back. Fond of the sand, it is mainly seen in the desert or jungle zones. Living underground, it surfaces when hungering for a snack.
monster_description.49: An azure-colored subspecies of Rathalos. More mobile than their standard cousin, they locate prey from the air and quickly swoop in for the kill. Once these master hunters select a target, there is little hope of escape.
monster_description.50: A giant dragon few have seen and lived to tell the tale. When on the rampage it wreaks havoc on all in its path. The guild has built a fortress to repel the beast, but will it hold?
monster_description.51: Leader of a Blango pack, it is twice as large and recognized by its giant fangs, whiskers, and head-crown. It sends its pack to attack any trespassers. Its jumping power allows it great mobility in its home range of the snowy mountains.
monster_description.52: A large pelagus sporting pink fur often spotted in the jungle and swamp zones. Fond of mushrooms, its diet affects its breath, which may be poisonous or flaming. One can predict these traits via the food in its local habitat.
monster_description.53: Ultra-aggressive creature that is rarely sighted and seldom survived. Survivors report it exhibits a strange attack. The Rajang is said to be a loner, and this isolated life has made it difficult to pin down its territorial leanings.
monster_description.54: A metal plated dragon known as the tempest of wind. Eyewitnesses report violent storms alongside the dragon, and its wide range means towns may be attacked.
monster_description.55: A giant Carapaceon with an equally giant monster's skull on its back. Prone to roaming and fiercely territorial, any intruders will be met with opposition, so nearby forts or towns must be warned of its presence.
monster_description.56: An abnormally large Thunderbug raised inside the body of an elder dragon and known to inhabit the same areas as its former host, its electrical attack is deadly. This bug has various uses as material for crafting weapons and items.
monster_description.57: A small, four-limbed monster known for always wearing a mask. Their camouflage-like qualities make them difficult to spot, but if you do, you're in trouble! Their leader, the King Shakalaka, is known to wear a crown like object.
monster_description.58: An Elder Dragon that floats through the sky. A bite of earth, a drink of forest, it’s a veritable god of the sky made of the richest soil. Ancient trees grow thick on its back like on a mountain. It’s rumored to live near a forlorn, remote tower.
monster_description.59: Eyewitness sightings of this Elder Dragon are extremely rare due to its ability to literally vanish; however, details of this are unclear. It is thought that shocking it may make it reappear, but this is unproven.
monster_description.60: A metal plated dragon known as the tempest of wind. Eyewitnesses report violent storms alongside the dragon, and its wide range means towns may be attacked.
monster_description.61: A Primatius covered entirely in white fur. Known to move in packs and led by a Blangonga. The Blangonga exerts tight control over the group, and any call to gather will be met immediately by the rank and file Blangos.
monster_description.62: Fanged, ape-like Primatius with pink fur. Prefers to live in small groups as opposed to large packs, and particularly enjoys mushroom snacks. If stumbled upon, it will be hostile, so beware of areas like the swamp or jungle.
monster_description.63: Small wyverns with outstanding flying abilities, they loiter in the skies waiting to prey upon weakened animals. Known to attack alongside Elder Dragons, they are known as an omen to disaster.
monster_description.64: A brutal female Elder Dragon with breath of flame and expert control over fire. It is said that this control comes from the crown-like horns on its head, but this has not been confirmed.
monster_description.65: A brutal male Elder Dragon with breath of flame and expert control over fire. Its vile temperament means anyone who approaches is subject to fire and brimstone. Known to attack towns, the Guild keeps tabs on its movements.
monster_description.66: A small Carapaceon with an incredibly hard shell. Known to live in great numbers in the desert, or lurking underground, one must be careful when treading in its domain. Its brains are said to be a true delicacy.
monster_description.67: A large Carapaceon with a giant monster's skull on its back. Its long, sharp pincers allow it to pierce volcanic bedrock and travel along ceilings. Sometimes, a precious and valuable pearl can be found inside its shell.
monster_description.68: The powerful leader of the wild boars known for its enormous tusks. More aggressive than a Bullfango, it is known to rush into a fight, and is extremely proficient at locating a foe.
monster_description.69: Herbivorous monsters living in the snowy mountains. Normally docile, but when provoked it will attack with its giant antlers. Its high quality pelt has many uses and its antlers are highly valued by the Guild.
monster_description.70: A herbivorous monster known for its giant, bent fangs. Living in herds, it is particularly bold when defending its offspring. Popo meat is quite nutritious, and its tongue is widely admired as a delicacy.
monster_description.73: An adolescent Carapaceon with an organic shell firmly placed on its back. Once grown, this shell will be replaced by a giant monster's skull. Mainly living in volcanic zones, it is very aggressive, and not to be underestimated.
monster_description.75: A flying wyvern that maintains its primitive origins. Prone to violence, it possesses incredible ferocity thanks to its four limbs, claws, and jaw. Inhabits a wide area, it has even been spotted hunting Popo in the mountains.
monster_description.76: A wyvern truly wrapped in mystery. Known to some as the black god and to others as the tyrant of fire, this large and brutal creature is known to the Guild simply as Akantor...
monster_description.77: The alpha leader of a pack of Giaprey, the Giadrome sports a beautiful crest. Larger than a Giaprey, any hunter silly enough to encroach on its turf will be frozen in a hail of ice.
monster_description.78: A breed of Yian Kut-Ku with a hard black shell and a long mane. Known for its trap avoiding slyness and poison loaded tail, it is a particularly evil wyvern, so beware!
monster_description.79: This Shakalaka chieftain pulls together the Shakalaka's as one, in order to act. Extremely quick to anger when approached, this hot-head can invoke his fiery wrath with emotion alone. Feared by even the most skilled hunters.
monster_description.80: A massive thorax and brilliant, gigantic wings mark the Vespoid Queen. It commands its subjects through unique flight patterns, and will stab any intruders with a poisonous stinger that also causes paralysis. It also spits acidic bodily fluid at its prey.
monster_description.81: A uniquely-evolved wyvern that calls the forest its home. It hides itself in the shadows and slyly stalks its prey with terrifying speed and tenacity. Its unique tail can take down a medium-sized monster in a single swish.
monster_description.82: A rust-colored bird wyvern with beautiful tail feathers found mainly in forests. A highly pacifistic wyvern by nature, it breathes sleeping gas on its enemies and prey alike. Its strong, developed legs pack a serious punch, so be careful!
monster_description.83: A piscine wyvern that resides in magma. Its scales are covered by layers of cooled magma, which makes it one hard nut to crack. It swims around in lava, spewing the molten rock it takes in at its prey… Researchers love to study its peculiar way of life.
monster_description.86: A large carapaceon with a giant monster's skull on its back. Fond of the sand, it is mainly seen in the desert or jungle zones. Living underground, it surfaces when hungering for a snack.
monster_description.87: A large Carapaceon with a giant monster's skull on its back. Its long, sharp pincers allow it to pierce volcanic bedrock and travel along ceilings. Sometimes, a precious and valuable pearl can be found inside its shell.
monster_description.88: A mysterious wyvern said to only appear after large avalanches deep in the snowy mountains. Often seen crushing ice balls and rock into powder in its stride, it’s known to the Guild as Ukanlos, although there are whisperings that it may be the white god...
monster_description.89: Ultra-aggressive creature that is rarely sighted and seldom survived. Survivors report it exhibits a strange attack. The Rajang is said to be a loner, and this isolated life has made it difficult to pin down its territorial leanings.

quest_details.1:
Within a group of the sly
carnivorous Giaprey, there
is a leader. They call it
the Giadrome. I need a
hunter's strength to show
that pack of beasts and
their leader who's boss!
quest_details.2:
My son decided to become a
hunter and ran off after a
Bulldrome on his own! Of
course, now the tables have
turned and I'm worried!
Hunt down the Bulldrome on
the snowy mountains!
quest_details.3:
A large pack of Blangos are
massing nearby. They are
violent enough that a large
group will quickly become
uncontrollable. Please slay
15 of the apes!
quest_details.4:
I want to pick some of this
village's famous Mountain
Herbs for my brother in
town, but there are too many
monsters! Could you please
go out for me and bring back
20 Mountain Herbs?
quest_details.5:
Do you know of a pink,
fanged beast that roams the
jungle? That beast has
dirtied my shop beyond hope!
It's impossible to clean up!
Get rid of it before I'm
soiled again!
quest_details.6:
I took a trip to the jungle
and saw some beautiful pink
animals with fangs. But when
I tried to pet them from my
carriage, the beasts made a
stink on me! I can't get it
off! Punish those meanies!
quest_details.7:
Mushrooms from the jungle
are skyrocketing in price!
If you were to gather 20 of
them for me, you would be
justly compensated. However,
I hear the area is infested
with carnivores, so beware!
quest_details.8:
A villager was tracking a 
pack of monsters, but lost 
sight of them in the desert.
Please find the leader of
the pack and hunt it down
for us.
quest_details.9:
A giant crab is wandering
around the desert! However,
no normal sword is capable
of cracking its shell! I
hate to ask for help from
other hunters, but please
lend me your skills!
quest_details.10:
I travel the world for new
tastes and flavors. Now I
want to try the liver of a
Piscine Wyvern, a taste few
others have experienced.
Please bring me 8 of these
livers!
quest_details.101:
We were exploring a
snow-covered mountain near
here, but stumbled on this
disgusting blob-like
monster! If you can't get
rid of that thing, our
research is doomed! Help us!
quest_details.102:
A Blangonga has staked its
claim to a piece of the
snowy mountains. Now we
can't enter the area to
gather firewood. Exterminate
the Blangonga!
quest_details.103:
Fishing is no easy endeavor,
but lately things have
gotten out of hand! While
unloading my ship, a swarm
of Hermitaurs appeared. Slay
10 of them and let me get
on with my work!
quest_details.104:
I found a giant water wyvern
in a cave in the desert! I
can't defeat it because it 
stays underwater. Slay it
for me and the glory is all
yours!
quest_details.105:
The fields all around the
town are getting torn to
shreds by a gigantic
poisonous bird-like monster.
Exterminate it for us! Its
poison can melt crops, so be
careful it doesn't melt you!
quest_details.106:
Hunters! It is time to hunt
down the Shogun Ceanataur.
Let us rid the swamp zone of
this menace and expand our
strategic possibilities.
This is a highly classified
hunt. So don't tell a soul!
quest_details.107:
A bird-like Yian Kut-Ku is
attacking people the world
over! It has even shown up
in these very hills! If it
isn't eliminated soon, we're
finished! Show me what
you're made of!
quest_details.108:
I request the assistance of
only the bravest of hunters
to find and hunt the
Rathalos that has appeared
near here. Of course, a
handsome reward will be paid
upon success.
quest_details.109:
My caravan was wiped out by
the queen of the skies, the
killer Rathian! I'll pay you
whatever you ask if you hunt
down that foul creature!
Help me kind hunter, you're
my only hope!
quest_details.1001:
A daytime gathering quest on
the snowy mountains. Gather
all the materials you can
from the field, then deliver
the Paw Pass Ticket to
finish up.
quest_details.1002:
A daytime gathering quest in
the jungle. Gather all the
materials you can from the
field, then deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket to finish up.
quest_details.1003:
A daytime gathering quest in
the desert. Gather all the
materials you can from the
field, then deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket to finish up.
quest_details.1004:
After you killed those
Giaprey, their leader showed
up and it's not a happy
camper! It's bigger, and has
a green crest. Find it and
kill it!
quest_details.1005:
The thick skinned Bulldrome
is well adapted to life in
the mountains. Yet it's
nothing but a pest for those
of us living amongst the
peaks! Which is why I'd like
you to get rid of it!
quest_details.1006:
I chased off a Giaprey that
was feeding on my Popos, but
now it's back with 19 of its
buddies! I can't take on the
whole lot of them! Hunters,
this is your chance! Please
get rid of them for me!
quest_details.1007:
Steeping Mountain Herbs in
this special brew has
miraculous medical effects.
However, I've run out of the
herbs essential to the
concoction. Find 20 of them
and bring them to me!
quest_details.1008:
It seems that whenever my
wife goes to pick mushrooms
in the Jungle, a large
carnivore appears! There's
no way I can let her go pick
mushrooms now... Please!
Make the Jungle safe again!
quest_details.1009:
I want you to hunt and kill
the giant bird-like monster
that has appeared in our 
jungle. It's wreaking havoc
on our environment!
quest_details.1010:
A group of blue scaled, pack
hunting carnivores called
Velociprey have infested the
jungle. Please slay 20 of
them for us... But beware of
their boss!
quest_details.1011:
My village is under attack
by a swarm of bug monsters!
It seems there are about 50
of them. One on one they are
not a threat, but as a group
they are deadly. So be
careful.
quest_details.1012:
My doggie just looooves
Special Mushrooms! I'd like
you to bring me 20 of them,
as I can't resist his puppy
dog eyes. However, beware of
that filthy pink vagrant
brute!
quest_details.1013:
I'd do anything to get my
hands on some legendary
Goldenfish! I'm begging you
to bring me 2 of them! Wait!
Make that 3! Please catch
these fish and bring them
here!
quest_details.1014:
My caravans are being hit by
packs of Genprey. It appears
there is an extraordinarily
powerful boss among them!
Hunt down the monster and
make the roads safe again
for all!
quest_details.1015:
Our pack-animals were eaten
by something in the desert.
But nobody actually saw the
monster attack! Track down
this vile beast and take 
it out!
quest_details.1016:
When some of my clan went
gathering in the desert,
they were attacked by an
enormous crab, nya! As long
as he's around, we can't do
business. Help us, nya!
quest_details.1017:
I'm too injured to go on...
The Genprey living in the
desert have the power to
paralyze their foes. I'd
like you to find the pack
that did this to me and kill
20 of the fiends!
quest_details.1018:
Hello sirs and madams! I
deal in rare items that I
find in the desert. Recently
I've got a buyer for Piscine
Wyvern and Sand Wyvern
livers. Deliver 10 of them
to me!
quest_details.1019:
Fishing. It carries on in
the hearts of children and
remains a simple pleasure
for adults. Hearken back to
a simpler time and bring me
back 3 of the desert's most
precious gift... Goldenfish!
quest_details.1020:
That big eared Yian Kut-Ku
really made mincemeat out of
me! It's out of my league,
so I want you to hunt it
down for me! He's all yours!
quest_details.1021:
We have a plan to rid the
swamp of the scourge of the
Bulldrome; however, we do
not have enough hunters for
the job. That is why we need
your help! Let us rid the
swamp of this foul beast!
quest_details.1022:
I took a trip to the swamp
and saw a pretty pink animal
with fangs. But when I tried
to call it to the carriage,
it threw something dirty at
me and now I can't get the
smell off! Punish it!
quest_details.1101:
A daytime gathering quest in
the swamp. Gather all the
materials you can from the
field, then deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket to finish up.
quest_details.1102:
A daytime gathering quest in
the forest and hills. Gather
all the materials you can
from the field, then deliver
the Paw Pass Ticket to
finish up.
quest_details.1103:
A daytime gathering quest in
the volcanic zone. Gather
all the materials you can
from the field, then deliver
the Paw Pass Ticket to
finish up.
quest_details.1104:
As the representative of the
Hunter's Guild, allow me to
lay out our request. We
would like you to hunt down
the proud ruler of the
mountains, the Blangonga...
But you must be prepared!
quest_details.1105:
We were exploring a cave
near here, but stumbled on
this disgusting blob-like
monster! If you can't get
rid of that thing, our
research is doomed! Help us!
quest_details.1106:
I've always longed to
venture into the snowy
mountains! I think I could
hunt down an Anteka, but I
could never fight a wyvern.
Maybe you could take care of
a special monster for me...
quest_details.1107:
The pelt of a Blango can be
made into various pieces of
armor that are useful in
everyday life. Slay 20 of
the beasts and bring me
their pelts. Beware of the
Blangonga.
quest_details.1108:
I'm after the rare larvae of
the Khezu. They should be
on the summit, so search
there. These whelps aren't
to be taken lightly. If you
run out of Pickaxes, combine
a bone with a rock!
quest_details.1109:
Hunt down the water wyvern
that keeps harassing my
shipyard! Your target is a
monster that can shoot water
with incredible force, so
beware! Heh heh heh!
quest_details.1110:
A huge group of Congas,
along with one of their big
pink bosses are gathering
together. Please get rid of
20 of them... I think it
will drive the rest away!
Help me, pretty please!
quest_details.1111:
I thought dark clouds had
covered the moon, but it was
actually a swarm of
Hornetaurs! The jungle is
covered with the bugs and I
need you to exterminate 50
of the Hornetaur pests!
quest_details.1112:
The lake underneath the
desert is connected to an
underground river and
patrolled by a green-scaled
water wyvern... If you are
truly a hunter, then it
should pose no problem.
quest_details.1113:
Those pesky Hermitaurs are
starting to get in the way
of business. They hide in
the sand and ambush you at a
moment's notice. I also
spotted a Daimyo Hermitaur,
so be extremely careful!
quest_details.1114:
I saw a gigantic bird-like
monster deep in the swamp!
It scared everyone so bad
that I can't do business
with a thing like that out
there! Please hunt it down
so I can work in peace!
quest_details.1115:
A Shogun Ceanataur is
running rampant over the
swamp zone! Whether it be
human or animal, it is
attacking everything in
sight. Head to the swamp
and end its reign of terror!
quest_details.1116:
The Gypceros is known to
have a fondness for shiny
objects. It is also known to
occasionally steal ore from
humans. Slaying a Gypceros
may net you some great
treasures.
quest_details.1117:
I'm a lumberjack and I'm not
OK. Those boar-monsters, the
Bullfangos, have been a lot
of trouble lately. Can you
thin the herd by 20? Much
obliged.
quest_details.1118:
This is awful! The princess
saw some strange masked
monsters that made her run 
for the hills! We're sending
troops on a hunt for the
fiends, so track down the
masked marauders!
quest_details.1119:
We were just in a fight with
a pack of Ioprey, but were
routed and had to retreat
before we could defeat their
leader. Hunt it down for us,
but beware of its poison
attacks.
quest_details.1120:
Upon our trip into the cave
at the volcano, an enormous
Shogun Ceanataur dropped
down from the ceiling right
on top of us! Its ambush
caused massive damage! Rid
the world of that scourge!
quest_details.1121:
A wyvern attacked my team
from out of the blue while
we were on an expedition to
the Volcanic Belt. Where did
it come from? Please slay
it!
quest_details.1122:
I wanted to keep digging in
search of the ultimate
treasure trove... But some
Ceanataurs smashed my
Pickaxe! If you don't get
rid of them, there will be
no digging for me! Help me!
quest_details.1123:
In a corner of the volcanic
belt, I discovered a great
vein of coal in the rocks.
I'd like you to mine the
coal, but beware the Shogun
Ceanataur! Take care and get
mining!
quest_details.1124:
A giant dragon has attacked
our fort! If the fort falls,
so too do our lands! Use its
installed weaponry to make
this beast pay for its
indiscretions!
quest_details.1125:
Help! There has been an
explosion of so many Daimyo
Hermitaurs near our fishing
grounds that we can't handle
things by ourselves! Get rid
of as many as you can so we
can get back to fishing!
quest_details.1126:
I've come from across the
sands to sell all manners of
strange and unusual wares,
but I have a request. Please
deliver to me 8 Goldenfish
from the desert. I promise
to reward you well!
quest_details.1201:
At last, the Tigrex has
appeared! It is said the
beast's origins are as a
flying wyvern. It is too
powerful to be allowed to
run free. The village is in
danger! Hunt it quickly!
quest_details.1202:
I have an urgent request
from a hunter on an
expedition in the desert! It
seems he has encountered the
mighty Tigrex! Go to his aid
and crush this beast at
once!
quest_details.1203:
A giant wyvern smashed the
border-wall and ran into
this area. We need to find
and kill it before it
causes any more trouble!
quest_details.1204:
I had hired the most skilled
hunters imaginable, and went
on a safari for the famed
Diablos... But what we found
was no mere Diablos! We must
slay that black horned
wyvern! No matter what!
quest_details.1205:
Even in the relative calm of
the swamp zone, something
has stirred up the monsters.
In particular, heavily
armored wyverns have been
attacking us. Can you help
us out?
quest_details.1206:
A fearsome Gravios has
appeared amidst the magma
and desolation of the
Volcanic Belt. Hunt down the
fire breather for us!
quest_details.1207:
Did you hear it!? That voice
that shook the ground? It
even scared the fearless
mercenaries! It must have
been the king of the skies!
But if you're a real hunter,
it won't be a problem!
quest_details.1208:
It cannot be... We tried so
hard to kill it... But... My
entire war band was wiped
out by a wyvern. Now it all
rests upon your shoulders,
monster hunter! Slay it!
quest_details.1209:
A Rathian is making its nest
in the jungle. This
protective mother has made
even stepping into the
jungle a death sentence.
Please clear the jungle of
her threat.
quest_details.1210:
A remarkably fierce Pink
Rathian has rampaged through
lands held by other monsters
and caused a great upheaval.
You must hunt down and
eliminate her to restore
order!
quest_details.1211:
That must have been the 
phantom beast... The faint
glow, and how it seemed to
glide over land... There's
no doubt that amazing riches
await its slayer!
quest_details.1212:
I must gather Herbs from the
hillside if I am to cure my
mother's illness. However, a
fire breathing wyvern has
settled into the area... If
I do nothing, mama will only
get worse. Please! Help me!
quest_details.1213:
A brown metal dragon is
rapidly closing on the town.
Scouts report that outlying
areas have already been
razed. If we don't stop this
dragon, our town will be
annihilated! We need you!
quest_details.1214:
While in the secluded desert
village, I spotted an elder
dragon with red scales!
While I do know some
hunters, it would be wrong
to make this request of
them... So it's up to you!
quest_details.1215:
I have an earnest request of
you... As the last of my
responsibilities, I request
your help. I want you to
fight the elder fire dragon
we cornered in the Volcanic
Belt, but beware its flames!
quest_details.1216:
Our intuition told us to
turn around, but we thought
no one was there... Yet even
though no one should've been
there, we were attacked from
behind! Beware! It was an
enemy never before seen!
quest_details.1217:
It seems an unknown elder
dragon has appeared in the
swamp zone. However, no one
truly got a clear look at
it. What could the beast
have been? Slay it, but
proceed with caution!
quest_details.1218:
Hmm... This is quite
serious. The fort which lies
at the heart of our defenses
is under siege by a giant
monster. We need your
strength to hold our
position!
quest_details.1219:
I was exploring the caverns
with my assistants when two
small, white shadows popped
out of nowhere. Please do
something about them as they
are hindering my research!
...Actually, what are they??
quest_details.1220:
Large Congalalas continue to
gather, and at this rate,
they'll completely trash the
Swamp and affect our town's
way of life. I'm not asking
that you get rid of them
all, but even 2 would help!
quest_details.2001:
A nighttime gathering quest
in the snowy mountains.
Gather all the materials you
can from the field, then
deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
to finish up. Be careful!
Large monsters lurk nearby!
quest_details.2002:
A nighttime gathering quest
in the jungle. Gather all
the materials you can from
the field, then deliver the
Paw Pass Ticket to finish
up. Be careful! Large
monsters lurk nearby!
quest_details.2003:
A nighttime gathering quest
in the desert. Gather all

quest_details.2004:
Within a group of the sly
carnivorous Giaprey, there
is a leader. They call it
the Giadrome. I need a

that pack of beasts and
their leader who's boss!
quest_details.2005:
My son decided to become a
hunter and ran off after a
Bulldrome on his own! Of
course, now the tables have
turned and I'm worried!
Hunt down the Bulldrome on
the snowy mountains!
quest_details.2006:
All the children in the
village have gathered their
allowances to pay you to get
rid of two carnivores. Our
parents couldn't do it, so
it's up to you to defend our
fields and animals!
quest_details.2007:
I've always longed to go
hunting in the jungle!
However, if a huge monster
appeared, I'd be finished!
Maybe you could take out 
the Daimyo Hermitaur for me?
quest_details.2008:
There appears to be two
Gendrome among the pack of
Genprey ravaging the desert.
This has caused the Genprey
to become frenzied and
attack humans. You must get
rid of the leaders!
quest_details.2009:
A giant sand wyvern has
appeared in the desert along
with a pack of Genprey.
Forget about the Genprey,
but take care of the
Cephadrome so the merchants
can return to work!
quest_details.2010:
I am a true connoisseur of
crab cuisine, and as such a
connoisseur, I suspect the
Daimyo Hermitaurs found in
the desert are incredibly
tasty! One is never enough,
so hunt down two!
quest_details.2011:
The Yian Kut-Ku are
circling, screaming in their
shrill voices. Everyone is
trapped inside the town!
Please do something!
quest_details.2012:
I asked some hunters to slay
a Congalala for me; however,
they met defeat at the
hooves of a Bulldrome. I
didn't think it would come
to this, but I need your
help!
quest_details.2013:
It's no use. No matter where
I look, I can't seem to find
the Vespoid Queen! Perhaps
if you slayed a large number
of Vespoids to make her feel
that her swarm was in grave
danger, she might appear...
quest_details.2101:
A nighttime gathering quest
in the swamp. Gather all the
materials you can from the
field, then deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket to finish up. Be
careful! Large monsters lurk
nearby!
quest_details.2102:
A daytime gathering quest
in the forest and hills.
Gather all the materials you
can from the field, then
deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
to finish up. Be careful!
Large monsters lurk nearby!
quest_details.2103:
A nighttime gathering quest
in the volcanic zone. Gather
all the materials you can
from the field, then deliver
the Paw Pass Ticket to
finish up. Be careful! Large
monsters lurk nearby!
quest_details.2104:
It happened in an instant...
Two Blangongas destroyed all
the trees around my house.
Now all I want to do is hunt
them down so I can get my 
revenge. Please help me!
quest_details.2105:
A Blangonga has staked its
claim to a piece of the
snowy mountains. Now we
can't enter the area to
gather firewood. Exterminate
the Blangonga!
quest_details.2106:
I wanted to test myself, so
I went off in search of
spotting a Bulldrome in the
snowy mountains. But all of
a sudden, a weird wyvern
appeared and it shocked me!
I'm still smoking!
quest_details.2107:
I've always longed to
venture into the swamp! I
think I could hunt down a
Kelbi, but I could never
fight a wyvern. Maybe you'd
take care of this special
monster for me...
quest_details.2108:
*cough* While I was
practicing in the jungle, I
was attacked by two poison
wyverns! You can see their
thick poison gas before your
very eyes... They are tough,
please defeat them! *cough*
quest_details.2109:
The water wyvern known as
Plesioth is raging in the
jungle. And not just one of
them! Head off immediately
to slay them!
quest_details.2110:
My caravan was wiped out by
the queen of the skies, the
killer Rathian! I'll pay you
whatever you ask if you hunt
down that foul creature!
Help me kind hunter, you're
my only hope!
quest_details.2111:
I found a giant water wyvern
in a cave in the desert! I
can't defeat it because it 
stays underwater. Slay it
for me and the glory is all
yours!
quest_details.2112:
The lake underneath the
desert is connected to an
underground river and
patrolled by a green-scaled
water wyvern... If you are
truly a hunter, then it
should pose no problem.
quest_details.2113:
The swamp's poison is mixing
with the Iodrome's poison...
It is a terrible scene! We
need a professional hunter
to assist us... Show us your
skills!
quest_details.2114:
Hunters! It is time to hunt
down the Shogun Ceanataur.
Let us rid the swamp zone of
this menace and expand our
strategic possibilities.
This is a highly classified
hunt. So don't tell a soul!
quest_details.2115:
I saw a gigantic bird-like
monster deep in the swamp!
It scared everyone so bad
that I can't do business
with a thing like that out
there! Please hunt it down
so I can work in peace!
quest_details.2116:
I request the assistance of
only the bravest of hunters
to find and hunt the
Rathalos that has appeared
near here. Of course, a
handsome reward will be paid
upon success.
quest_details.2117:
Hey! Hey! Have you heard the
news!? There's a rumor that
two enormous monsters with
thick shells have appeared
in the Volcanic Belt! There
must be a hunter somewhere
who can face them!
quest_details.2118:
A wyvern attacked my team
from out of the blue while
we were on an expedition to
the Volcanic Belt. Where did
it come from? Please slay
it!
quest_details.2119:
The volcano has erupted with
a deluge of black snake-like
wyverns. They are the envoys
to disaster. Hunt 20 of
these Remobras down and
appease the mountain gods.
quest_details.2120:
It seems that once again our
land is in crisis. The giant
elder dragon Lao-Shan Lung
is approaching the village
from the mountains. Head to
the fort and defend our way
of life!
quest_details.2121:
It-it-it's awful! A group of
Blangongas are gathering on
the mountain! With all those
brutes in one spot, it means
trouble for the village!
Please help us!
quest_details.2122:
We came to this land seeking
the fabled Kirin, and at
last we had found it! But
the heavens opened and
lightning struck, scattering
our team. We need your help
to save our co-workers!
quest_details.2123:
Have you ever heard of
"Select Mushrooms"? Collect
just 3 of them and you'll be
rich beyond belief! Although
I have heard that the King
Shakalaka keeps a tight
watch over those things...
quest_details.2124:
The Hypnocatrice, the sleep-
inducing bird wyvern of the
Great Forest. Those who face
it usually end up taking a
dirt nap, so its materials
are highly coveted. So...
You gonna give it a shot?
quest_details.2125:
Oh, the atmosphere is abuzz,
and the land tells me of the
monsters' fury! Great
Hunter, I call upon you to
put a stop to the Blue Yian
Kut-Ku and the Rathian that
appears after it falls!
quest_details.2126:
Oh me, oh my! A Daimyo
Hermitaur and a Green
Plesioth have both appeared
in the same area. I'm in
search of a hunter who'll
rid me of them one by one.
Won't anyone step forward?
quest_details.2127:
A Khezu and a Shogun
Ceanataur have descended
upon the swampland and
are really going at it! If
we don't put an end to them
quick, we may end up with a
lot of casualties! Heeeeelp!
quest_details.2201:
A group of highly skilled
hunters went off to slay two
Tigrex, but they became
the hunted. Please destroy 
the two Tigrex and open 
a clear route for our
rescue team.
quest_details.2202:
I had never seen the fanged
beast with two horns on its
head before, and I never
want to again with the way
it was rampaging across the
snow!
quest_details.2203:
I have an urgent request
from a hunter on an
expedition in the desert! It
seems he has encountered the
mighty Tigrex! Go to his aid
and crush this beast at
once!
quest_details.2204:
I've always longed to
be a hunter, but a meeting
with a Rathian ended that!
Now that I know what it
takes, I'll start over, but
you have the spirit to hunt
down that Rathian!
quest_details.2205:
A giant wyvern smashed the
border-wall and ran into
this area. We need to find
and kill it before it
causes any more trouble!
quest_details.2206:
I had hired the most skilled
hunters imaginable, and went
on a safari for the famed
Diablos... But what we found
was no mere Diablos! We must
slay that black horned
wyvern! No matter what!
quest_details.2207:
I simply can't bear to think
about the terror and pain
those Diablos are causing my
people. I can't sleep at
night with that worry! Hunt 
down those 2 Diablos for me!
quest_details.2208:
I went up to the snowy
mountains to view the
aurora, but the truth is
that I hate the cold! That's
when it hit me! I should
have a coat made from Rajang
fur! Hunt one for me!
quest_details.2209:
A fearsome Gravios has
appeared amidst the magma
and desolation of the
Volcanic Belt. Hunt down the
fire breather for us!
quest_details.2210:
Even in the relative calm of
the swamp zone, something
has stirred up the monsters.
In particular, heavily
armored wyverns have been
attacking us. Can you help
us out?
quest_details.2211:
A Rathalos and Rathian have
paired up and are ravaging
my country! I wanted to end
their reign of terror, but
my father will not allow it!
Please! Defeat them for me!
quest_details.2212:
Did you see the two wyverns
that appeared in the hills?
An azure-shelled Rathalos
and a pink-scaled Rathian...
Hunting them down would
surely make you a top
hunter! ...Try your luck?
quest_details.2213:
It cannot be... We tried so
hard to kill it... But... My
entire war band was wiped
out by a wyvern. Now it all
rests upon your shoulders,
monster hunter! Slay it!
quest_details.2214:
I have a request to all
excellent hunters. I would
like you to hunt down the
silver wyvern that lives in
the forgotten tower. OK...
You don't even have to be
excellent.
quest_details.2215:
All of my rations were gone
and I was fading out of
consciousness when out of
the corner of my eye I saw
ancient ruins and a golden
wyvern up above. Was it all
a dream? Find the truth!
quest_details.2216:
I saw them! I really did!
The ground was bathed in
sparks as two phantom beasts
bathed in a lava pool! It
was not a dream! You've
gotta believe me! Go see for
yourself!
quest_details.2217:
I saw it! I saw it! In the
middle of a blinding snow
storm, there it was; dark
black wings were dancing in
the sky... No mere human
could stand up to it! Don't
even think of hunting it!
quest_details.2218:
There was surely a vortex
inside of that downpour. The
wind wrapped around and
revealed the elder dragon,
Kushala Daora! There isn't
a single soul who can combat
it alone, so fight together!
quest_details.2219:
This is truly an emergency!
A red fire-breathing dragon
is approaching this very
town! This is no time to
dilly-dally! We need the
help of every skilled hunter
in this land!
quest_details.2220:
I have an earnest request of
you... As the last of my
responsibilities, I request
your help. I want you to
fight the elder fire dragon
we cornered in the Volcanic
Belt, but beware its flames!
quest_details.2221:
Our intuition told us to
turn around, but we thought
no one was there... Yet even
though no one should've been
there, we were attacked from
behind! Beware! It was an
enemy never before seen!
quest_details.2222:
It seems an unknown elder
dragon has appeared in the
swamp zone. However, no one
truly got a clear look at
it. What could the beast
have been? Slay it, but
proceed with caution!
quest_details.2223:
The legendary black
dragon... It really exists
then? We've prepared all
instruments of war to assist
you in your quest to destroy
the dragon. The fate of the
nation lies in your hands.
quest_details.2224:
It appears the time has
finally come. The
bloodstained scales of the
red dragon have graced the
earth again in flaming
glory. If you can stop this
beast...
quest_details.2225:
Our town is embroiled in an
unprecedented conflict. A
fortress-like shelled
monster is threatening our
safety. We need help 
immediately!
quest_details.2226:
The combined strength of the
Hunter's Guild has
successfully cornered an
Akantor in the Volcanic
Belt. Now all that is left
is to slay the beast, a task
for only the most valiant.
quest_details.2227:
Hee hee hee... The time has
come. Here is your
invitation to the ball. Wear
your Sunday best and bring
your greatest weapon, for it
is time to go to the dance
with the king of disaster.
quest_details.2228:
The Nargacuga of the Great
Forest... It's so fast, I
could barely see it. But
please, if there is one
request that needs to be
fulfilled, it's this one!
quest_details.2229:
All of my friends... gone.
I saw a tail swish through
the air, and 2 red lights.
That's all. That thing's
not a monster; it's a
demon! Someone exorcise it,
please!
quest_details.2230:
Think you can handle two
Rathian at the same time!?
Then come on down to the
Arena, the only place to
test your might! We eagerly
await your arrival, Hunter!
quest_details.2231:
Ah, I tried to slay it, but
I was in way over my head.
Still, I can't let it go, so
I ask that if you have the
courage to face this beast,
to please step forward.
quest_details.2232:
I've received an urgent
communique from my colleague
who went to investigate deep
inside the volcano. Please
hurry, but be careful. The
monster is a bit... unique.
quest_details.2233:
Wh-What's going on...?
All of a sudden, a ton of
monsters just showed up in
the Snowy Mountains! Any
hunter willing to lend a
hand, please come help us
on the hunt!
quest_details.2234:
Help! There are some
dangerous monsters lurking
in the Forest and Hills,
making it impossible for me
to enter the area. But if I
don't gather what I need,
my mother's illness will...
quest_details.2235:
We've received word that a
Basarios and a Gravios are
going wild inside due to
volcanic activity. This is
a very dire situation, and
we require the immediate
dispatch of a hunter.
quest_details.2236:
My sister and I are in an
argument over which is the
most beautiful: Daimyo
shells, Cephadrome scales,
or Diablos horns. Seeing is
believing, so I demand you
bring all three to me!
quest_details.3001:
A daytime gathering quest in
the Great Forest. Gather all
the materials you can from
the field, then deliver the
Paw Pass Ticket to finish
up. Just be aware of the
G-Level monsters, OK?
quest_details.3002:
A gathering quest in the
Old Jungle. Gather all the
materials you can from the
field, then deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket to finish up.
Just be aware of the
G-Level monsters, OK?
quest_details.3003:
A gathering quest in the
Old Desert. Gather all the
materials you can from the
field, then deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket to finish up.
Just be aware of the
G-Level monsters, OK?
quest_details.3004:
A gathering quest in the
Old Swamp. Gather all the
materials you can from the
field, then deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket to finish up.
Just be aware of the
G-Level monsters, OK?
quest_details.3005:
A gathering quest in the
Snowy Mountains. Gather all
the materials you can from
the field, then deliver the
Paw Pass Ticket to finish
up. Just be aware of the
G-Level monsters, OK?
quest_details.3006:
This time, I need a hunter
to come with us as we go in
search of treasure in the
heart of the Great Forest.
More specifically, I need
you to be on the look-out
for Shakalakas as we travel.
quest_details.3007:
It's no use. No matter where
I look, I can't seem to find
the Vespoid Queen! Perhaps
if you slayed a large number
of Vespoids to make her feel
that her swarm was in grave
danger, she might appear...
quest_details.3008:
The Hypnocatrice, the sleep-
inducing bird wyvern of the
Great Forest. Those who face
it usually end up taking a
dirt nap, so its materials
are highly coveted. So...
You gonna give it a shot?
quest_details.3009:
The Hypnocatrice is hurting
so many people, so I tried
to sneak out to the Great
Forest. Unfortunately, I was
spotted by a guard. Please,
I ask that someone deal with
that menace in my stead!
quest_details.3010:
The Yian Kut-Ku are
circling, screaming in their
shrill voices. Everyone is
trapped inside the town!
Please do something!
quest_details.3011:
We came here to the Old
Jungle in search of some
materials when a giant crab
chased us out of the area,
nya!  We can't make a living
as long as that cretin is
there. Please help us, nya!!
quest_details.3012:
I spotted an unusual variety
of Daimyo Hermitaur out in
the Old Desert. I don't know
what it was, but I swear it
was evil! Anyway, here's my
proposition: Hunt the crab
and make a fortune. Deal?
quest_details.3013:
My grandfather stumbled on a
fight between two famous
warriors. They say that it's
the dream of a warrior to
die on the battlefield, but
not by their own hands!
Please go and help them!
quest_details.3014:
Just when I thought that
maybe this time the peace
would last, this happens!
As long as that Khezu just
sits there, we can't get out
of the Old Jungle. Please,
come to our rescue, hunter!
quest_details.3015:
I've always longed to
venture into the Snowy
Mountains! I think I could
hunt down an Anteka, but I
could never fight a wyvern.
Maybe you could take care of
a special monster for me...
quest_details.3016:
Ever since a long time ago,
2 gruesome wyverns have
lived in the depths of the
cave in the Old Swamp, their
blood-red bodies surrounded
in a sharp, blue glow...
*gasp!* Look, behind you!
quest_details.3017:
The Plesioth of the Old
Desert's underground lake...
We've received an SOS from
the group of secret hunters
who were hunting this beast.
Can you keep the Plesioth at
bay while we rescue them?
quest_details.3018:
Help! I've received word
that a Green Plesioth has
appeared along our Queen's
route to another land.
Please take care of it in
secret for us before she
enters the area!
quest_details.3019:
Congas have gathered in the
Swamp and are destroying all
the good mining points. Now,
I'd hate for this to leak,
but there's a great mining
point in a secret place.
Just keep that mum, OK?
quest_details.3020:
Hmph, how rude! Can you
believe that awful beast
spewed some nasty gunk at
me three times in a row!?
...I beg your pardon?
I still stink!? How dare
you, you uncouth heathen!?
quest_details.3021:
There is a child wandering
lost deep in the Great
Forest. Our rescue efforts
have thus far failed due to
a strange and rare, bearded
beast... I ask that someone
please hunt that thing down!
quest_details.3022:
That Gypceros stole my very
important Book of Combos,
and then, right after that,
a band of Melynx stole my
BBQ Spit! At this rate, I'm
going to be forced into
early retirement! Heeeeelp!
quest_details.3023:
Gypceros are covered in a
rubbery skin that's mostly
waterproof, yet despite
this, they like to live in
areas of high humidity.
Hmm... To solve this riddle,
I'll require more data!
quest_details.3024:
Add a Blue Yian Kut-Ku to a
Green Plesioth and you get a
Plum D.Hermitaur. Seriously,
uniquely-colored equipment
is selling like hotcakes,
especially with young folks.
Wish I could get in on that.
quest_details.3025:
Recently, the number of
people disappearing in the
swamplands has been on the
rise and we think the reason
is linked to monsters in the
area. If you can, please
help look into this for us.
quest_details.3101:
A gathering quest in the
Forest & Hills. Gather all
the materials you can from
the field, then deliver the
Paw Pass Ticket to finish
up. Just be aware of the
G-Level monsters, OK?
quest_details.3102:
A gathering quest in the
Old Volcano. Gather all the
materials you can from the
field, then deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket to finish up.
Just be aware of the
G-Level monsters, OK?
quest_details.3103:
I saw a demon in the Great
Forest so fast that I could
barely even register its
shadow as it flew by. My
trusty partner is my sword,
and I hate to beg, but I
need some backup here!
quest_details.3104:
Our head drill sergeant was
attacked while out on an
expedition in the Old Swamp
by an unknown assailant. We
think it's probably a
monster, but we require the
assistance of a hunter!
quest_details.3105:
From within the midst of the
Great Forest's mist, I saw
two blood-red eyes! Rest
assured I will pay you well,
just please, someone come
defeat this creature quick!
quest_details.3106:
I'm in a fishing competition
with my elder brother. We
agreed to compare rubbings
to determine the winner.
Well, imagine how much I'd
win by if I had a Lavasioth
rubbing! I'm a genius!
quest_details.3107:
From out of the rivers of
lava came 2 Lavasioths! I am
dead serious. And right in
front of a good Powderstone
deposit! Please, dear
hunter! Hunt these two down
so we may get back to work!
quest_details.3108:
The Arena! A place to show
your skills to the world!
For this event, we have
released two crab-like
enemies into the arena! All
those ready to test their
skills are welcome!
quest_details.3109:
Upon our trip into the cave
at the volcano, an enormous
Shogun Ceanataur dropped
down from the ceiling right
on top of us! Its ambush
caused massive damage! Rid
the world of that scourge!
quest_details.3110:
I was going to get some
materials after my catnap
from what I thought was an
empty black shell, but it
took off, nya! I'm so mad
that I didn't get anything!
You'd better help me, nya!
quest_details.3111:
My grandfather stumbled on a
fight between two famous
warriors. They say that it's
the dream of a warrior to
die on the battlefield, but
not by their own hands!
Please go and help them!
quest_details.3112:
We were enjoying a lovely
picnic in the forest, where
even the small birds had
come out of hiding to bathe
in the sunlight. But then,
a lick of flame came out of
nowhere! What was that!?
quest_details.3113:
Unbelievably, the king of
all wyverns has appeared in
the Old Volcano belt. To
protect our temple, we went
to fight it, but to no
avail. Please, we humbly ask
for your assistance, hunter!
quest_details.3114:
Do you hear that? A voice
that makes the earth
tremble. Soldiers who have
never known defeat are
knocked about by this sky
king's roar, but that's what
hunters are for, right?
quest_details.3115:
In order to hunt down the
ferocious Rathian in our
lands, we are asking for
volunteers. Hunters! Show us
your strength and hunt that
which is called "Empress".
quest_details.3116:
The terrible Pink Rathian.
It invades other monsters'
territory and throws them
into disarray, and picks
fights with them as well. We
must quickly rid the world
of such a dangerous monster!
quest_details.3117:
Heh, at long last I have
laid eyes upon my prey, the
Great Forest's Yian Garuga,
though never in my wildest
dreams did I think it would
be so strong! Hunter, I call
upon your assistance now.
quest_details.3118:
Yian Garuga have appeared
in the forest areas one by
one. Unending cycles of
inflamed violence has caused
many casualties in the area.
For the sake of the people,
please do something quick!
quest_details.3119:
A Blangonga has staked its
claim to a piece of the
snowy mountains. Now we
can't enter the area to
gather firewood. Exterminate
the Blangonga!
quest_details.3120:
My teacher believed that a
subspecies of Blangonga
lives in the arid sands of
a desert, and went in search
of it. People have forgotten
about my teacher, but I want
to know what happened!
quest_details.3121:
Oh my! I'm sure that was a
Blangonga, but they only
live in areas of extreme
cold! What is one doing out
here!? Ahh, I have no idea
what's going on anymore, but
please do something!
quest_details.3122:
I was hiding from a Basarios
behind some boulders when it
turned out to be another
one! I thought I could hide
behind some other boulders
ahead of me, but it was yet
another one! Somebody, help!
quest_details.3123:
We've received word that an
airship made an emergency
landing in the Jungle, but
the area is home to a Daimyo
Hermitaur, a Gypceros, and a
Rathian. Hurry to the region
and help hunt them down!
quest_details.3124:
There's something strange in
the air, and it's attracting
all manner of monsters all
at once! Right now, there's
only 1 hunter for every 3
monsters so any help you can 
give would be fantastic!
quest_details.3125:
The young master has gone on
a most impossible hunt, I'm
afraid; all for the hand of
a certain beautiful lady
knight. I fear it will not
end well, so I ask that you
please help him along!
quest_details.3126:
I went to open up the arena
that no one has used in a
while. Lo and behold, it's
now a den of monsters! They
seem to like it there so
much they were immediately
up in arms. Please help me!
quest_details.3127:
It seems that once again our
land is in crisis. The giant
elder dragon Lao-Shan Lung
is approaching the village
from the mountains. Head to
the fort and defend our way
of life!
quest_details.3201:
At last, the Tigrex has
appeared! It is said the
beast's origins are as a
flying wyvern. It is too
powerful to be allowed to
run free. The village is in
danger! Hunt it quickly!
quest_details.3202:
A group of highly skilled
hunters went off to slay two
Tigrex, but they became
the hunted. Please destroy 
the two Tigrex and open 
a clear route for our
rescue team.
quest_details.3203:
I have heard that there is a
hunter in this village of
great skill. We have sent
scores of soldiers, yet they
are no match for the Diablos
of the Old Desert. Please
lend us your power, Hunter!
quest_details.3204:
I had hired the most skilled
hunters imaginable, and went
on a safari for the famed
Diablos... But what we found
was no mere Diablos! We must
slay that black horned
wyvern! No matter what!
quest_details.3205:
SOS! Two gigantic black
towers came rising out of
the ground and threw us into
disarray. The pressure of
tens of thousands of troops
on us; so this is a wyvern's
might. Please help us out!
quest_details.3206:
Even us knights can't stand
up to the Gravios's mighty
heat ray. I know this is a
big request, but can you
please go and hunt this
armored beast in our stead?
quest_details.3207:
A fearsome Gravios has
appeared amidst the magma
and desolation of the
Volcanic Belt. Hunt down the
fire breather for us!
quest_details.3208:
Hunters who were escorting
some scholars were attacked
by a few Gravios. They
managed to fend them off,
but they are unable to leave
the area. Please hurry to
their rescue!
quest_details.3209:
I'll tell you about a secret
hunting ground, I will. It
doesn't matter if it's day
or night, the silver sun
always shines, giving would-
be hunters a good workout...
Heh, heh, heh...!
quest_details.3210:
We were dazed and lost in a
haze for days when we came
upon a mysterious land.
There, we spied a golden
moon. If I tell you the
location, will you look into
the area for me in secret?
quest_details.3211:
The silver-winged king and
his gold-bodied queen. 
Whoever successfully hunts
them both shall be known as
the King of Hunters. I await
your return with a glass
held high!
quest_details.3212:
The legendary Rajang has
appeared at last, however, I
will leave it for you other
hunters as I have other
matters to attend to. I have
people back home waiting for
my return, after all.
quest_details.3213:
There are two Rajang, each
with golden fur. Hunters, I
have prepared a special
stage for your grandest
performance. Demonstrate
your true power... He he
he...
quest_details.3214:
They say there's a secret
place where all manners of
ancient monsters live
together, and I have found
it at long last... If you
want, I will show this
virgin land to you!
quest_details.3215:
There's something causing
lightning strikes in the
heart of the Old Swamp. My
theory is that this is proof
that the mythical beast has
come out of hiding. Isn't
it absolutely fascinating?
quest_details.3216:
The sprawling city in the
oasis is under siege by a
number of monsters. This is
unprecedented! We must do
what we can before something
terrible befalls the city!
quest_details.3217:
I'm checking out the
disturbance in the Swamp.
The large monsters are
going crazy and there are a
ton of casualties. Help fend
them off so that we can find
the source of the trouble.
quest_details.3218:
I don't usually make
requests, but today's an
exception since I don't feel
my best. ...What? H-How dare
you!? I-I could do this job
in my sleep! It's that easy!
Ah, just come back safe...
quest_details.3219:
Recently, the weather around
the Snowy Mountains has been
bad nonstop. Further, the
monsters are hungry from a
lack of food, and have
started to violently attack
each other. Please help us!
quest_details.3220:
I went to open up the arena
that no one has used in a
while. Lo and behold, it's
now a den of monsters! They
seem to like it there so
much they were immediately
up in arms. Please help me!
quest_details.3221:
If I don't pass this
exercise, my father will
force me to marry. But I've
already sworn to myself that
my only partner in life
would be my trusty sword.
Please, I need your help!
quest_details.3222:
If you see a giant twister
at night out on the dunes,
you'd best run. That is no
ordinary sandstorm, but a
legendary Elder Dragon. But
if you think you can defeat
it, then please go ahead!
quest_details.3223:
There was surely a vortex
inside of that downpour. The
wind wrapped around and
revealed the elder dragon,
Kushala Daora! There isn't
a single soul who can combat
it alone, so fight together!
quest_details.3224:
The Teostra's hideaway can
only be found during the
darkest hour, but I have
done it. Now, if you can
keep a secret, I'll tell you
where it is, and of course
you will be well rewarded...
quest_details.3225:
I have an earnest request of
you... As the last of my
responsibilities, I request
your help. I want you to
fight the elder fire dragon
we cornered in the Volcanic
Belt, but beware its flames!
quest_details.3226:
People think it's impossible
to fight an enemy you cannot
see, however, if one were to
focus and "see" with their
gut instinct... Well, if all
else fails, just swing your
weapon round and round!
quest_details.3227:
It seems an unknown elder
dragon has appeared in the
swamp zone. However, no one
truly got a clear look at
it. What could the beast
have been? Slay it, but
proceed with caution!
quest_details.3228:
We have confirmed the Yama
Tsukami's location at the
old Tower! There is so much
we have yet to understand
about this floating dragon
that we can't let this
chance escape! Move out!
quest_details.3229:
Our town is embroiled in an
unprecedented conflict. A
fortress-like shelled
monster is threatening our
safety. We need help 
immediately!
quest_details.3230:
The legendary black
dragon... It really exists
then? We've prepared all
instruments of war to assist
you in your quest to destroy
the dragon. The fate of the
nation lies in your hands.
quest_details.3231:
It appears the time has
finally come. The
bloodstained scales of the
red dragon have graced the
earth again in flaming
glory. If you can stop this
beast...
quest_details.3232:
Hee hee hee... The time has
come. Here is your
invitation to the ball. Wear
your Sunday best and bring
your greatest weapon, for it
is time to go to the dance
with the king of disaster.
quest_details.3233:
This village already owes
you so much, but we need you
now more than ever. I truly
believe it has to be you.
Please, go forth to the
Snowy Mountain Peaks and
fight the final fight!
quest_details.4001:
Gather the treasure that
lies sleeping in the field
to earn points. I will
calculate your total and
reward you based on how much
you can collect. Leave no
treasure undiscovered!

Gather the treasure that
